meta_description:
22K likes, 109 comments - natgeo on October 13, 2026: "Presented by National Geographic Society in partnership with @Rolex. In the face of a changing world, these explorers are not giving up hope for our seas. Narrated by @auliicravalho, set sail across all five ocean basins in Expedition: Saving Our Seas, premiering Friday, November 13 at 9/8c on @natgeotv. Streaming next day on @DisneyPlus and @hulu.

Rolex and The National Geographic Society are partnering on science-based expeditions to explore, study, and document change in the planet’s unique regions. #PerpetualPlanet.".
